units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 16:4">Yeb. XVI, 4</cite> (<cite ref="Yevamot 121a:20">121ᵃ</cite>) <he>מים … שאין להם ס׳</he> waters without end (the shores of which you cannot see from all sides).
<cite ref="Nedarim 62a:8">Ned. 62ᵃ</cite> <he>וס׳ הכבוד לבא</he> and honor will finally come of itself.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 71:2">Gen. R. s. 71</cite>, beg. (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 69:34">Ps. LXIX, 34</cite>) <he>לא ראשו … סוֹפוֹ ולא סופו ראשו</he> the first clause of this verse does not correspond (in syntactical construction) to its final clause &c. Sifra K’dosh. ch. III, Par. 2 <he>אם גנבת סוֹפְךָ לכחש וכ׳</he> if thou stealest, thou wilt finally deny &c.

<cite ref="Megillah 7a:2">Meg. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>בתחלה קבעוה בשושן וְלִבְסוֹף וכ׳</he> at first they established it (the festival of Purim) in Shushan, and then for the whole (Jewish) world; a. v. fr.—<he>לא ס׳ דבר אלא …</he> this is not the end of it …, but.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 38:3">Gen. R. s. 38</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 17:13">Prov. XVII, 13</cite>) <he>לא ס׳ ד׳ משיב וכ׳</he> after all, not only he who requites evil for good, but even he who requites evil for evil &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 3:5:2">Y. Shebi. III, end, 34ᵈ</cite>; a. fr.

senses.gloss: remnant, esp. pl. סוֹפִין fruit remaining on the tree after harvest time, late fruit.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 12:3:2">Y. Yeb. XII, 12ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>קידש בגופו של ס׳</he> (prob. to be read <he>בנוֹפוֹ</he>) if one betrothed a woman, giving as a consideration a branch of a tree of his containing remainders (mostly worthless).

<cite ref="Pesachim 6b:13">Pes. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>סוֹפֵי … ומשמר וכ׳</he> if there are in a man’s field late figs, but he watches his field for the sake of the grapes; v. <cite ref="O00405"><he>סוֹפֶת</he></cite>.—[<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Metsia 2:8">Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. II, 8</cite> <he>סופין</he> ed. Zolk., read: <cite ref="O00232"><he>סוֹבִין</he></cite>.]
